comparisons.peer_topic: Definition and Recognition of Unbilled Receivables
comparisons.peer_summary: Unbilled receivables are recorded within Prepaid expenses and other current assets and primarily represent work completed on development services and custom products under non-cancellable purchase orders with no alternative use, recognized as revenue but not yet invoiced.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose that specific assets related to their business operations (prepaid capacity for NVDA and unbilled receivables for AMD) are classified within the 'Prepaid expenses and other current assets' line item on the balance sheet. NVDA explicitly links this classification to short-term prepaid supply and capacity agreements ($2.5 billion), while AMD explains that unbilled receivables for development services and custom products are recorded in the same current asset category.

sentences.text: (1)As of January 28, 2024 and January 29, 2023, there was an additional $2.5 billion and $458 million of short-term prepaid supply and capacity agreements included in Prepaid expenses and other current assets, respectively.
